final_parent_mechanism.zh: 成对编辑效应工作流更新策略

terminal_reason.zh: 旧 certificate/objective 已停止；parent lineage pivot 为真正 persistent workflow update operator。hidden workflow 禁止 candidate trials/search，只允许 exactly one persistent edit commit。
terminal_reason.en: The old certificate/objective is stopped; the parent lineage pivots to a true persistent workflow update operator. Hidden workflows forbid candidate trials/search and allow exactly one persistent edit commit.

pre_p0_gate.zh: 冻结 typed edit library、source paired single-edit intervention table、hidden workflows 与 zero-search editor。
pre_p0_gate.en: Freeze the typed edit library, source paired single-edit intervention table, hidden workflows, and zero-search editor.

strongest_baseline.zh: calibrated absolute predictor + threshold；nearest-neighbor edit-effect reuse。
strongest_baseline.en: Calibrated absolute predictor plus threshold; nearest-neighbor edit-effect reuse.

minimum_p0.zh: source workflows 学真实 ΔU(edit|workflow,failure)，hidden workflow 禁试跑并只提交一个 edit，以 programmatic post-commit truth 评估。
minimum_p0.en: Learn true DeltaU(edit|workflow,failure) on source workflows; on hidden workflows forbid trials and commit exactly one edit, judged by programmatic post-commit truth.

exact_stop.zh: predictor+threshold 同等有效，或提升只有 prediction accuracy 而未改善 persistent committed outcome，则停止。
exact_stop.en: Stop if predictor+threshold is equally effective or gains improve only prediction accuracy without persistent committed outcomes.

current_fact.zh: E-1 当前 frozen paired edit-effect source table 触发 ranking-substrate STOP：16 个 workflows×5 edits 中仅 4/16 有任何正 edit，只有 3 个 workflow 的 edit delta 可唯一排序，effective fraction=25%。因此 STOP_CURRENT_EDIT_TABLE_RANKING_DEGENERATE；hidden workflows 未打开，Paired Edit-Effect Workflow Update Policy 方法本体未判。
current_fact.en: The current E-1 frozen paired edit-effect source table fires a ranking-substrate STOP: among 16 workflows x 5 edits, only 4/16 have any positive edit and only 3 workflows have uniquely rankable edit deltas, for an effective fraction of 25%. Therefore STOP_CURRENT_EDIT_TABLE_RANKING_DEGENERATE fires; hidden workflows were never opened and the Paired Edit-Effect Workflow Update Policy itself is not adjudicated.

final_parent_mechanism.zh: 失败模式因果重写注册表

terminal_reason.zh: 结构 credit、group intervention 验证与 frozen typed local rewrite 统一成一个机制；不是 credit estimator/grammar/editor 三篇。
terminal_reason.en: Structural credit, group-intervention verification, and frozen typed local rewrites are one mechanism, not three papers.

pre_p0_gate.zh: 冻结 semantic/execution graph、group-intervention budget、identity/API-disjoint split 与 3–6 条 typed rewrite rule 容量。
pre_p0_gate.en: Freeze the semantic/execution graph, group-intervention budget, identity/API-disjoint split, and a capacity of 3–6 typed rewrite rules.

strongest_baseline.zh: E-1 one-shot paired edit-effect policy + CE-Graph-style editor，matched calls。
strongest_baseline.en: E-1 one-shot paired edit-effect policy plus a CE-Graph-style editor at matched calls.

minimum_p0.zh: 单图+surrogate 排 structural credit，少量 group interventions 验关键 subgraphs；跨 identity/API-disjoint workflows 重复 motif 后编译 frozen rewrite，hidden zero-search apply。
minimum_p0.en: Rank structural credit from a single graph+surrogate, verify key subgraphs with few group interventions, require motifs to recur across identity/API-disjoint workflows, compile frozen rewrites, and apply zero-search on hidden workflows.

exact_stop.zh: E-1/CE-Graph 等效则 merge into E-1/drop；规则只记 node/API name 也停止独立 E-2。
exact_stop.en: If E-1/CE-Graph is equivalent, merge into E-1/drop; also stop standalone E-2 if rules memorize node/API names.

current_fact.zh: E-2 CPU P0 已触发 matched-simplification STOP：16 个 source workflows 覆盖 4 类 failure motif，每类 4 次；causal grammar 与 E-1-style typed paired edit-effect baseline 都严格使用 32 个 source calls。冻结后在 8 个 API/identity-disjoint hidden workflows 上，两者均 8/8 success、0 harmful rewrite、0 hidden search，且 8/8 选择完全相同的 rewrite。结构 credit/group intervention 没有产生超出直接 paired edit-effect reuse 的独立价值，建议并回 E-1/CE-Graph，等待人工确认 merge/drop。
current_fact.en: E-2 CPU P0 fired a matched-simplification STOP. Sixteen source workflows cover four failure motifs with four repetitions each; the causal grammar and an E-1-style typed paired edit-effect baseline both use exactly 32 source calls. After freezing, both achieve 8/8 success, zero harmful rewrites, zero hidden search, and identical rewrites on all eight API/identity-disjoint hidden workflows. Structural credit/group intervention adds no value beyond direct paired edit-effect reuse, so E-2 should merge back into E-1/CE-Graph pending human merge/drop review.
